Cocaine Blackout
I have ADD (I don't know if this factor comes into play). I used to sit around with different groups of 'friends' and while doing mass amounts of lines, or smoking coke/crack, a few things occurred.
#1 I thought I was finding notes from one person in the group to the next, usually 'scratched' into toilet paper or plastic baggies. I heard this is called 'underground railroading'.
#2 The group would have me lay lines out for them. When I got my product out and opened the baggy, it seemed that a lot more product would dissapear, or the baggy would be missing and replaced with another one in my pocket with cut product the next time I got it out.
Was I tweaking, or could I have blacked out or been caused to blackout. I noticed they would usually carry a light device of some kind, like a flashlight. Would this have caused me to blackout somehow by shining it in my eyes? Am I crazy?
